warhead.provenance: 45 kg shaped-charge warhead per OOB (csg-cn-yu7-gs; csg-cn-yu7-wsn, C-only). Explosive/case split and damage are engineering-estimate surrogates for a lightweight ASW torpedo shaped-charge warhead, following the repo's mk48_adcap.json underwater-damage-calibration pattern scaled down for this smaller weapon.

fuze.provenance: No public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate contact fuze scaffold typical of a shaped-charge lightweight ASW torpedo.

_real_world.role: Lightweight ASW torpedo, ship-launched (triple tubes) and helicopter-delivered
_real_world.range_nmi: 10 km (csg-cn-yu7-wsn) to 14 km (csg-cn-yu7-gs), conflict likely speed-dependent, C-only
_real_world.guidance_real: Active/passive acoustic homing, no wire guidance; GlobalSecurity claims 90% acquisition probability (unverified, C-only)
_real_world.propulsion: Otto-fuel II thermal, twin contra-rotating propellers
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for torpedoes; placed only in _real_world.weapon_inventory. Ship-launched from 2x triple 324 mm tubes (Type 7424B) on Type 052D, Type 055, Type 054A; also the payload of the CY-5/Yu-8 VLS ASW rocket and carried by Z-9C/Z-18F/Z-20F helicopters
